title: AdmissionDecision
description: The reified outcome of the admission gate pipeline for one governed attempt (proposal 0043, CHP-CORE-029). Binds the exact invocation (invocation_id + invocation_digest) to a single admitted/denied result and the invariant/gate evaluations that produced it. Unifies what were separate per-gate decisions (entitlement/matter/screen + core invariants). Admission is not execution and not effect (CHP-CORE-001).

invariant_evaluations.description: Refs to the invariant/gate evaluations that produced this decision. status is the four-state satisfied/unsatisfied/unknown/error; unknown or error MUST NOT be treated as satisfied (CHP-CORE-017).

denial.description: Present when result is denied. chp-dev extension over the package v0.1 candidate (which carries no denial field) — the reserved DenialReason (code/message). Pending upstream into the 0043 candidate.
